CustomField.description: Pipeline Health: Health Score Pre-Close. Closed deal analysis field used for win and loss reporting.
CustomField.formula:
CASE( Last_Stage_Pre_Close__c,
"Stage 1", S1_Milestone_Score__c,
"Stage 2", ( S1_Milestone_Completion__c + S2_Milestone_Completion__c ) / 22,
"Stage 3", ( S1_Milestone_Completion__c + S2_Milestone_Completion__c + S3_Milestone_Completion__c ) / 42,
"Stage 4", ( S1_Milestone_Completion__c + S2_Milestone_Completion__c + S3_Milestone_Completion__c + S4_Milestone_Completion__c ) / 51,
"Stage 5", ( S1_Milestone_Completion__c + S2_Milestone_Completion__c + S3_Milestone_Completion__c + S4_Milestone_Completion__c + S5_Milestone_Completion__c ) / 57,
NULL )
